name: Tome of the Cabal (quest item)
summary: The Tome of the Cabal is a grimoire entrusted to warlocks by Strahad Farsan on the bluffs overlooking Ratchet. It holds the perilous incantations necessary to pull a ravenous felhunter across the Twisting Nether and bind it to the summoner's will.

sections.title: A Gateway to the Nether
sections.body: Felhunters are vicious, mana-devouring beasts native to the chaotic expanse of the Twisting Nether. Subduing one is a rite of passage for seasoned warlocks, and the rituals required to tear open a pathway for such a beast are contained within the pages of the Tome of the Cabal. Strahad Farsan, an experienced conjurer operating out of Ratchet, provides the tome only after an aspirant has proven capable of gathering the rare and hazardous components needed to fuel its magics.

sections.title: The Summoning Ritual
sections.body: Summoning from the tome is far from a solo endeavor. Strahad establishes a primary summoning circle within his sanctum, while his acolytes employ rods of channeling to construct a greater protective boundary. The warlock must then recite the tome's exact incantations to drag the felhunter into our world, immediately battling and subduing the ravenous demon to cement their dominion over it.

faq.q: What is the Tome of the Cabal used for?
aliases: what does tome of the cabal do
faq.answer: The tome contains the ritual incantations required to summon a felhunter from the Twisting Nether into a specially prepared circle in Ratchet, allowing a warlock to face and bind the demon.

faq.q: Who provides the Tome of the Cabal?
aliases: who gives tome of the cabal
where to get tome of the cabal
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan, a warlock mentor living in the hills above Ratchet in the Barrens, provides the book once a practitioner has completed the arduous preparatory tasks.

faq.q: Do you keep the tome after completing the ritual?
faq.answer: No. Once the summoned felhunter is defeated and your mastery is proven, you return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan as proof of your success.

faq.q: Can you summon the felhunter anywhere in the world?
faq.answer: No. The incantations must be read within Strahad Farsan's sanctuary above Ratchet, where he and his acolytes maintain the greater and lesser summoning circles required to contain the beast upon arrival.

angles.text: Every practitioner of the dark arts seeking dominion over demonic magic must master this tome to claim their felhunter companion.
